title: Charge visibility: user stories, sketches, and reconciliation tasks
content:
Purpose:
This is a working doc to capture user stories, quick wireframe notes, reconciliation tasks, and export schema ideas for a new "charge visibility" view in Console. The goal is to help customers understand allocated charges at a glance, reconcile invoices with internal ledger items, and export the right slices for cost centers and GL reconciliation.

Context / problem statement:
- Customers and platform teams often get invoices that are hard to map back to internal charge codes or product features.
- The current Console bill/invoice pages show totals and per-model breakdowns but lack a first-class way to: map charges to internal cost centers, mark manual adjustments, and generate CSVs suitable for finance teams.
- We want an intermediate UI surface between raw invoice PDF and detailed per-token telemetry: "Charge visibility" — a reconciliable, exportable, and alertable view.

Primary user personas:
- Finance analyst (reconcile monthly invoice to GL)
- Platform/Infra owner (track spend by team or project)
- Product manager (monitor cost trends for feature launches)
- SRE/ops (watch for allocation spikes, attach incident notes)

High-level objectives:
- Make it easy to map invoice line items to internal cost centers and GL codes.
- Provide export presets (CSV/Excel) that match finance templates.
- Support manual adjustments and annotations persisted per-month.
- Surface alerts for allocation drift (e.g., charge moved from service-A to service-B).
- Keep latency and token-cost signals reachable from this surface (link to trace).

User stories (ranked):
1) As a finance analyst, I want to see a per-invoice table where each charge line can be assigned a cost center and GL code so I can export a CSV to ingest into our ERP.
   - Acceptance: inline edit cost center and GL code, bulk apply to multiple lines, export includes assigned codes, audit trail shows who changed mapping.

2) As a platform owner, I want to define allocation rules (by route, model, tag) so that future invoices auto-populate cost center mappings.
   - Acceptance: rule builder with preview on historical data, ability to enable/disable rule, rule priority ordering.

3) As an ops engineer, I want to attach a short note or ticket link to a charge line (e.g., "incident: burst on 2025-01-09") so that downstream reviewers understand anomalies.
   - Acceptance: per-line annotations, search by annotation text, exported annotations included as a column.

4) As a finance analyst, I want export presets (Monthly-ERP, Quarterly-review, Internal-CSV) and the ability to save a custom preset.
   - Acceptance: preset selector, preview columns, save-as-new, perm-based access.

5) As a product manager, I want a small visualization (sparkline + percent change) on each cost center in the invoice view to quickly spot growth.
   - Acceptance: 1-line sparkline for 3 month window, hover for exact values.

Wireframe / layout notes (quick sketch verbalization):
- Top: Invoice selector / period picker / Download PDF / Export button + preset dropdown.
- Left column (narrow): filters (team, model, tag, allocation-rule, unassigned-only toggle).
- Main table: columns [line description, model, route, raw charge, allocated cost center, GL code, annotation, sparkline(3mo), reconciliation status].
- Row actions: edit mapping, add note, open telemetry, mark reconciled/unreconciled.
- Right rail (collapsible): summary by cost center (total, trend, percent of invoice), quick totals, unresolved items badge.
- Footer: audit trail link, export history, contact support.

Export schema draft (CSV columns):
- invoice_id, invoice_date, line_id, line_description, model, route, raw_charge_usd, currency, allocated_cost_center, gl_code, annotation, reconciliation_status, reconciled_by, reconciled_at, export_preset_name

Edge cases to handle / questions:
- Partial refunds and credit notes: how do they appear in allocation? (suggest show as negative line with linked original line)
- Multi-resource lines (e.g., a gated request that charged to both hosting and model fees): need support for split allocations (allow percentage split across multiple cost centers).
- Late manual adjustments from finance after export: should keep a separate adjustment log and a "locked" flag for exported months.
- Currency conversion: invoices may be in USD primarily, but customers with billing in local currency need both amounts.
- Large-line volume: tables might be thousands of lines — add lazy-loading + bulk operations.

Backlog / grooming tasks (rough tickets):
- B1: prototype main table + inline mapping UI (MVP) - PD + FE spike (2 sprints)
- B2: export presets + CSV generator + e2e test (1 sprint)
- B3: allocation rule engine UI (rule preview on 90d) + backend rule evaluation (2 sprints)
- B4: annotations & audit trail storage + search (1 sprint)
- B5: split allocation support (backend and UI) + validation UX (2 sprints)
- B6: reconcile status workflow (reconciled/unreconciled/under-review) + permissions (1 sprint)
- B7: alerts for allocation drift (threshold config + Slack/email integration) (1 sprint)

Metrics / success signals:
- Reduction in time-to-reconcile per invoice (target: 50% faster first month)
- Number of exported CSVs using presets (adoption metric)
- Percentage of invoice lines auto-mapped by rules (target 70% within 60 days)
- Number of annotations created per invoice (engagement)

Design considerations / constraints:
- Permissions: only billing admins and finance role should edit GL codes. Regular users can suggest mappings but require approval.
- Auditability: every mapping change should capture user, timestamp, and origin (manual vs rule).
- Performance: previewing rule matches over 90d must be async with sampling to avoid high cost.
- Privacy: annotations may contain ticket links; ensure we don't leak internal ids to customers if shared.

Open questions for team:
- Do we want to persist per-customer custom export presets or per-org? (recommend per-org with user-owned drafts)
- Is split allocation a must-have for MVP or relegated to later milestone?
- Should "reconciled" state sync to external CRMs/ERP? (requires API + webhook design)

Next steps / immediate action items:
- PD: create low-fidelity mockups for desktop and narrow-screen views (due: 2025-02-21) — assignee: Sofia Li
- Eng: spike backend changes needed for storing allocations and rule engine preview sample (due: 2025-02-28) — assignee: Ben Carter
- Finance partner: gather two sample ERP CSV templates from customers (due: 2025-02-20) — assignee: Maya Thompson
- Sync: schedule a 45m cross-functional grooming session to refine acceptance criteria and priority (schedule: week of 2025-02-24)

Notes from quick design session (2025-02-18):
- Prefer discrete tags for cost centers instead of free text to encourage consistent mapping.
- Bulk rules should default to the most specific matching field (route > model > tag).
- Export should include a "reconciliation checksum" (simple hash of line_id + assigned GL) to help finance detect tampering.

Attachments / sketches: (placeholders)
- hand-sketched-table-v1.png (attached to doc in Drive)
- sample-erp-template.xlsx (uploaded to shared drive under /product/finance-samples)
